import Foundation

struct Reading: Codable {
    let tag: String
    let value: Double?
}

/* A comment can /* contain another comment */ and continue
   across the next line. */
func describe(_ reading: Reading) -> String {
    guard let value = reading.value else {
        return #"missing "value""#
    }
    let label = """
        tag: \(reading.tag)
        value: \(value)
        """
    return label
}

let samples = [Reading(tag: "café", value: 4.25), Reading(tag: "quiet", value: nil)]
let labels = samples.map { describe($0) }
print(labels.joined(separator: "\n"))
